description: Randomly generate a structured, configurable study-practice plan (学习实践表). Lays the plan out as day x time-slot cells, assigns every cell a study topic and a concrete practice item, keeps topics from repeating until the topic pool is exhausted, keeps a day's time slots non-overlapping, varies each session length inside a reasonable interval, and prints the result as a Markdown table (or plain text / JSON). A --seed flag makes any run reproducible. Implemented with the Python 3 standard library only; it does not call the Huawei Cloud CLI, any Huawei Cloud SDK, or any REST API, and it touches no cloud resource. Triggers include: "生成学习实践表", "随机生成学习计划", "学习安排", "帮我排学习计划", "生成学习表", "study plan", "random study plan", "study schedule", "learning plan", "practice plan".
